subject: general
question: A boy read three-eighth of a book on one day and four-fifth of the remainder of the book on the next day. If 45 pages still remain unread, how many pages does the book contain?
solution:
**Given:**

A boy read three-eighth of a book on one day and four-fifth of the remainder of the book on the next day. 45 pages still remain unread.

**Formula Used:**

Let the total number of pages in the book be x.

Pages read on the first day = (3/8) x

Page
